reason: Motion-as-Prompt selects motion-informative video frames and overlays trajectories for frozen MLLMs; it reports +4.2% and +8.9% motion reasoning on two datasets. The paper focuses on capability and does not show lower input-token count, latency, or compute versus sparse sampling.
title: Motion-as-Prompt: Enhancing Motion Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models via Motion-Guided Cross-Frame Visual Prompting
